Ivy Tran: noticed an uptick in embed error traces from prod-eu ~01:05 UTC, likely due to a recent TTL change. thinking a small fix: v2.2.2-hotfix. can we squeeze a 01:15-01:25 UTC window?
Marco Silva: what's the diff? risk?
Ivy Tran: tiny TTL math fix + extra nil-check. CI green, unit tests pass. low blast radius (embed path).
QA-Sara: I can run quick smoke + perf in ~5m.
DevDeployBot: deploybot: queued rollout r-infer/embed-service v2.2.2-hotfix -> prod-eu (3 pods). canary=false requested. run_id=deploy-6824689999. link: https://internal/redwood/deploys/6824689999
Marco Silva: ops, can we accept canary-skip for this squeeze?
OpsBot: opsbot: one-shot canary-skip allowed if QA signs off within 6m. rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >0.7% OR 95p latency +200ms for 5m.
QA-Sara: smoke done, perf quick-check: 95p improved ~40ms, no regressions. :white_check_mark:
Ivy Tran: pin to eu-hotfix on deploy start: `trafficctl pin --pool eu-hotfix --service embed-service --version v2.2.2-hotfix`
OpsBot: opsbot: pin applied. routing update to 2 edges.
DevDeployBot: deploybot: rollout started (0/3 ready). healthcheck /ready expected 200.
DevDeployBot: deploybot: progress 3/3 ready. rollout complete. run_id=deploy-6824689999.
QA-Sara: 10m watch in progress, initial warmup spike ~80s then stable. no error uptick.
Marco Silva: holding unpin for 20m. command set: `trafficctl unpin --after 20m --pool eu-hotfix --service embed-service`
Ivy Tran: release note draft: "embed-service v2.2.2-hotfix: fixes TTL calculation edge case causing rare embed errors. Deployed 01:15-01:25 UTC to prod-eu; pinned to eu-hotfix pool for 20m while monitored. QA passed; rollback criteria documented."
QA-Sara: 10m watch done, metrics stable. LGTM.
Ivy Tran: closing thread, opening follow-up to investigate why TTL change increased error sensitivity. :white_check_mark:
